CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION protected_capture.capture()
 RETURNS TABLE(database_oid oid, backend_pid integer, xid xid8, person_oid oid, actor_oid oid)
 LANGUAGE sql
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$ SELECT (SELECT oid FROM pg_database WHERE datname=current_database()),pg_backend_pid(),pg_current_xact_id(),
(SELECT oid FROM pg_roles WHERE rolname=session_user),(SELECT oid FROM pg_roles WHERE rolname=current_user) $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION protected_capture.entry(token bytea, attempt bigint, payload bytea)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$ BEGIN
 -- This candidate admits the fixed login only; SET ROLE requires a separate profile.
 IF current_user <> session_user OR current_user <> 'pc_actor' THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'Protected capture unavailable' USING ERRCODE='42501';
 END IF;
 PERFORM protected_capture.write($1,$2,$3);
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION protected_capture.revoke_actor()
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE sql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$ UPDATE protected_capture.authority SET permitted=false,generation=generation+1
 WHERE actor_oid=(SELECT oid FROM pg_roles WHERE rolname='pc_actor') $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION protected_capture.revoke_assignment()
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$ BEGIN
 UPDATE protected_capture.authority SET generation=generation+1
 WHERE actor_oid=(SELECT oid FROM pg_roles WHERE rolname='pc_actor');
 UPDATE truss.edge SET props=pg_catalog.jsonb_set(props,'{403}','false'::pg_catalog.jsonb) WHERE id=100 AND rel_type_id=41;
END $function$

 RETURNS void

 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$ SELECT protected_capture.entry($1,$2,$3) $function$
